title: PO-8960 High-Voltage Contactor EDI Over-Reporting & Phantom Inventory
question: ERP says all 3,200 units of HV-CONT-400A on PO-8960 from Apex Wafer Corp are DELIVERED_COMPLETE, and Accounts Payable is about to release full payment. However, Bin-B14 physical count does not match. Query Zetaris across ERP, WMS, QMS, and EVA Air cargo manifests to prove where the missing 1,100 units actually are and protect Line-B runway.
expected_conflicts: ERP batch import shows 3,200 units DELIVERED_COMPLETE vs WMS RFID gate count of 2,100 units (1,100-unit phantom inventory discrepancy).
Carrier feed CAR-905 and QMS-435 prove Apex Wafer Corp combined two split shipments into one EDI ASN; 1,100 units were rolled to flight BR-0624 (+72h delay).
